objects.name: Smouldering remains with small key
objects.description: Scenery (the small key lies by its hand as an item, picked on touch). Charred robot remains lying on floor 32 (map cell 110-111, row 31, about 2 x 1 tiles). Pickup of item record 1 (TORZO) at engine (105, 26) renames it MALÝ KLÍČ: "U tlejících zbytků jsi našel malý klíč".

objects.name: Small key
objects.description: Item prop by the skeleton's hand on floor 32, picked on touch. Inventory item (record 1, shown as TORZO until picked). Opens the electric cabinet (marker 9) and is consumed there. Inventory art: open. Drawn with the mesto crane key art.

objects.name: Electric distribution box (fuses)
objects.description: Wall box with a green panel on floor 32 (use window map cells 146-150, art about cells 148-149, rows 29-31). First use (map M21) pulls out one fuse (an empty slot and a blinking red lamp, the box stays intact, user): power off, map M22 (energy barrier and bridge vanish). Using the fuse there in M22 restarts the power plant: map M23.

objects.name: Teleport
objects.description: Small teleport pod with a dish top on floor 23 (use window map cells 127-130, art cells 128-129, rows 20-22). Sends the hero to the target teleport (cell 65, floor 32) once the navigation circuit and the fuse are fitted; else says the target teleport is damaged (or the power plant is off in M22). Two-way.

objects.name: TOASTER weapon pickup
objects.description: Bonus weapon (slot 3) lying at the east end of the bridge, engine (55, 35) = map cell 61, floor 41. Gives 250 shots; the only weapon that hurts the walkie-talkie guard. Not drawn in the map tiles (sprite or invisible, open).

refs.caption: map M21: pickup spot, floor 41 (item not in tiles)

objects.name: Guard post across the bridge
objects.description: No art of its own: a code wall (engine 48, floor 41, solid near cell 52) at the east end of the bridge with the message "Nemůžeš jít dál, na druhé straně mostu je hlídka". Using the walkie-talkie at cells 52-57 calls the guards away and removes it.

objects.name: Walkie-talkie guard
objects.description: Guards the walkie-talkie, not the bridge. Bulky olive armoured soldier with a rifle, facing right (LEV2.GRA frame 25, 8 frames of 3x3 tiles). Stands on floor 23 at map cell 62; 70 hit points, only the toaster hurts him (6 per hit). Blocks the hero and fires bursts. The walkie-talkie lies behind him at cell 60.

refs.caption: map M21: guard spot, floor 23 (sprite not in tiles)

objects.name: Walkie-talkie
objects.description: Item record 2 on floor 23 behind the walkie-talkie guard, engine (54, 17) = map cell 60. Used at the bridge east end it calls the guard post away; it stays in the inventory.

refs.caption: map M21: pickup spot (item not in tiles)

objects.name: Target teleport (damaged)
objects.description: Same teleport pod as marker 3 on floor 32 (use window map cells 63-67, art cells 65-66, rows 29-31). The navigation circuit repairs it ("Opravil jsi rozbitý teleport"); then it links to the marker 3 pod both ways while the fuse is fitted. The walkthrough map swaps markers 5 and 6 in height; code puts the guard on floor 23 and this pod on floor 32.

objects.name: Detonator
objects.description: Item record 4 on floor 50, engine (73, 44) = map cell 79. Used at the dynamite wall after the dynamite is placed: level end.

refs.caption: map M21: pickup spot (item not in tiles)

objects.name: Crate with cannon projectile
objects.description: Item record 3 (BEDNA) on floor 50, engine (109, 44) = map cell 115. Picking it renames it PROJEKTIL: "Uvnitř bedny jsi našel projektil do děla". Label: hazard stripe block and AMMO.

refs.caption: map M21: pickup spot (item not in tiles)

objects.name: Cannon projectile
objects.description: Inventory item from the crate; loaded into the cannon (marker 12) and consumed.

objects.name: Locked electric cabinet
objects.description: Concrete cabinet block with a grey door on floor 59 (use window map cells 122-126, art about cells 122-128, rows 55-58). Locked ("Elektrická skříň je zamčena") until the small key is used; then gives the fuse.

objects.name: Fuse
objects.description: Inventory item (record 7) from the cabinet; fitted into the fuse box while the power is off (map M22).

objects.name: Dynamite
objects.description: Item record 5 on floor 68 by the ruined house, engine (93, 62) = map cell 99 ("U domu jsi našel dynamit"). Placed at the wall (marker 14) it moves to engine (25, 26) and can no longer be picked up.

refs.caption: map M21: pickup spot by the house (item not in tiles)

objects.name: Broken teleport
objects.description: Wrecked teleport pod on floor 59 (use window map cells 93-98, art about cells 94-96, rows 57-58). Gives the undamaged navigation circuit once.

objects.name: Navigation circuit
objects.description: Inventory item (record 6, NAV. OBVOD); fitted into the target teleport and consumed.

objects.name: Border cannon
objects.description: Blue-grey artillery gun with rust drips and a hazard band along the body bottom on floor 41 pointing west, with a wooden watchtower behind it (art about map cells 33-43, rows 35-40; use window cells 31-38). "Útočný kanón na hlídání hranice města". With the projectile it blasts the barricade: map M24.

refs.caption: map M21: cannon and tower, floor 41

objects.name: Burning barricade
objects.description: Grey steel post in a mossy frame (map cell 22, rows 38-40: panel, diagonal brace and pipes, beige rails) with a lower stone and rail block (cell 23, rows 39-40). The original's ammo depot run behind it (AMMO plate bays and graffiti walls, cells 24-29) is left out (user). The post tiles (8,50) (8,63) (8,76) are a stand-row wall; M24 blasts the post away and leaves a jagged mossy stub, a graffiti stone slab, a red crate shard and rubble in cell 23.

objects.name: Teleport pair
objects.description: Unconditional two-way teleport: use at map cells 50-54 on floor 50 goes to cell 42 on floor 32, use at cells 40-44 on floor 32 goes back to cell 52. Art not identified in the map tiles (open).

objects.name: Wall to blow up
objects.description: Grey steel post in a mossy frame (map cell 29, rows 29-31, stand-row wall: panel, diagonal brace and pipes, beige rails). The original's ammo depot run behind it on floor 32 (AMMO plate bays and graffiti walls, cells 30-38) is left out (user). Dynamite then detonator here ends the level.

objects.name: Electric barrier
objects.description: White crackling electric arc one tile wide, rows 37-40 at map cell 99 on floor 41, tiles (1,1)-(1,4), a stand-row wall. Gone in M22 (power off), back in M23 and M24.

objects.name: Bridge over the chasm
objects.description: Thin light rail bridge, one plank row (tiles (2,1)-(2,3)), map cells 45-56 on floor 41 between the barricade side and the toaster spot. M22 removes the planks: a hero who steps on the gap falls (engine y 36 plays padves.anm).

objects.name: Holo plan
objects.description: Owned from the level start (record 8 owned flag set by the init), so the map screen works. Inventory item only.

objects.name: Energy pickup
objects.description: Bonus at engine (77, 17) = map cell 83, floor 23: energy + 90, once. Not in the map tiles (sprite or invisible, open).

objects.name: Ammo pickup
objects.description: Bonus at engine (123, 35) = map cell 129, floor 41: machine-gun ammo + 350 (cap 999), once. Not in the map tiles.

objects.name: Shield pickup
objects.description: Bonus at engine (35, 35) = map cell 41, floor 41 (west of the bridge): shields + 1 (cap 5), once. Not in the map tiles.

objects.name: Lift platform and shaft
objects.description: Same lift as mesto: 9 lifts, deck tiles (10,1)-(10,3) at every stop, a rung rail column in the shaft. Two stops each, 9 rows apart.

refs.caption: map M21: lift 1 shaft and decks

objects.name: Night jungle sky
objects.description: Sky role. Night teal sky in flat tone bands, two rows of palm silhouettes, pale ruined concrete walls and bushes along the bottom; the original LEV2.GRA frame 0 backdrop in our own vector look. Drawn stretched over the whole map height.

objects.name: Rock cliff
objects.description: Rubble role. Rounded tan boulders with moss, spilling down a slope from the full height at the left to the floor at the right (flip mirrors it), sized w and h in cells; the cliffs on the crate masses (cells 50-60 rows 14-24, 6-14 rows 34-49).

refs.caption: map M21: east cliff by the spawn

objects.name: Stone wall
objects.description: Filler role (deep terrain art and the fill behind rock cliffs). A rectangular mass of the rock cliff boulders, sized w and h in cells, so the rock masses read as stone, not crate blocks (user, 2026-11-03).

objects.name: Grassy stone walkway
objects.description: Floor role (terrain ledge). Dry grass tufts and dirt over a row of grey curb stones with moss, one cell thick, sized w; every floor row of the original (cells 58-66 row 23).

objects.name: Chain-link fence
objects.description: Fence role. Same mesh fence panels between steel posts as mesto, with small grey sign plates; mesh: grey-green mesh between steel tube posts every 3 cells, top and bottom rails, grey sign plates with red bars; torn: rusty hole with wire ends. Sized w (cells 58-66 rows 20-22, 62-75 rows 38-40).

objects.name: Overhead pipeline
objects.description: Pipe role, hung from the ceiling (hangs). Double pipe with orange hazard clamps along rows 25-26, hung every 3 cells from a concrete housing with an amber lamp; sized w, drawn from the ceiling 8 cells above its floor (cells 118-150 rows 24-26).

objects.name: Vertical pipe column
objects.description: Pipe role. Thick vertical pipe with ring joints, mesto concrete column; bronze: flanged ring joints every 2 cells, verdigris and rust, sized h (cell 60 rows 33-41, cell 85 rows 24-32).

objects.name: Riveted storage tank
objects.description: Machine role. Squat rust-brown riveted cylinder tanks with a lid and hatch, a pipe stack with lamps between them (cells 124-130 rows 27-31); horizontal: bronze tank on two steel legs with a hatch and a gauge on its face (cells 128-133 rows 37-40, 138-143 rows 28-31).

objects.name: Horizontal tank
objects.description: Horizontal bronze tank with curled end pipes on short legs (about 4 x 2 tiles) on floors 32 and 41; mesto fuelTank role, without the trefoil.

objects.name: Power plant transformer
objects.description: Machine role. Green-grey transformer on a concrete plinth: cooling fins, a stacked chrome coil, porcelain bushings with wires, valve wheels, a high-voltage plate, oil leak (cells 121-127 rows 34-40).

objects.name: Wooden watchtower
objects.description: Support role. Timber hut with a slit window, a corrugated roof and a lamp on splayed braced legs with a ladder; behind the cannon (cells 36-40 rows 34-40).

objects.name: Concrete village house
objects.description: Building role. Pale concrete house, storeys of 3 cells, end piers, windows (some boarded, some sooted), sills with drips, a door; ruined: broken roof, shell breach with scorched rim and rebar, an arch hall, rubble. Sized w and h (cells 38-49 rows 43-49, 91-100 rows 61-68).

objects.name: Timber building on stilts
objects.description: Building role. Timber block with window rows and corner posts on braced concrete stilts, corrugated eave; burnt: charred lower walls, holes, broken roof planks. Sized w and h (cells 89-98 rows 50-58, 63-76 rows 34-40).

objects.name: Crate block mass
objects.description: Filler role (terrain wall). Olive steel crate panels, one per cell, with a diagonal brace, a stile and a yellow seam strip under every row, dents and rust; the solid masses under the cliffs and the never reached rock (cells 50-60 rows 15-24, 140-145 rows 50-58).

refs.caption: map M21: crate blocks under the cliff

objects.name: Lattice column
objects.description: Support role. X-braced column of the crate steel with riveted chords, sized h; state 0 carries an amber lamp box every 3 cells like the original lamp tiles (cells 136, 141, 148 rows 12-30; 118 rows 27-31).

objects.name: Power plant machinery
objects.description: Machine role. Three lattice towers with two crossarm gantries, insulators with blue arcs, two coil banks, a grilled control cabinet with a high-voltage panel, a domed tank and a bronze pipe gantry on a concrete plinth (cells 126-141 rows 12-22).

objects.name: Far palm grove
objects.description: Far role. Flat dark palm and bush silhouettes with grain, sized w and h; state 1 adds a ruined wall with window holes and a scorched breach. Fills open sky between floors.

objects.name: Far village ruin
objects.description: Far role. Flat dark silhouette of a ruined two-storey block with dark windows and a scorched hole, or a village water tower on braced legs; sized w and h.

objects.name: Riveted steel wall
objects.description: Wall role. Grey-blue riveted steel plates in offset courses with rust streaks and bullet holes; state 0 ends in a bolted I-beam post, state 1 is infill. Sized w and h; the original floor-end riveted blocks (cell 76 row 22, cells 93-99 row 58).

objects.name: Timber plank wall
objects.description: Wall role. Vertical timber planks between posts with nailed battens, missing planks and rot; burnt: charred lower half, scorched holes. Sized w and h.

objects.name: Riveted deck plate
objects.description: Floor role. Riveted grey-blue steel deck plates with tread lines, rust and a seam strip, sized w (cells 93-100 row 59).

refs.caption: map M21: steel plates in floor 59

objects.name: Truss walkway
objects.description: Girder role (terrain girder). Free-standing floor run: grassy stone deck over a bronze steel truss between two stone end piers, sized w.

objects.name: Concrete power house
objects.description: Building role. Pale concrete utility house with barred vent grilles, a steel door with a green high-voltage panel, a cable run and insulators on the roof; damaged: broken roof with a blue arc, a breach. Sized w and h (cells 105-112 rows 35-40, 76-80 rows 19-22, 121-128 rows 55-58).

objects.name: Amber lamp box
objects.description: Mounted role. Dark iron box with a caged amber lamp and label strips, about 2 cells above its floor, on a wall, column or machine (the lamp tiles on the lattice columns, cells 130-148 rows 12-30).

refs.caption: map M21: lamp tiles on the columns

objects.name: High-voltage junction box
objects.description: Mounted role. The mesto wire box (green steel box, hazard bolt plate) on a steel pole to the floor; open: door hanging, torn wires (cell 79 row 21, cell 107 row 39).

objects.name: Rubble heap
objects.description: Rubble role. Low heap of broken stones, or of concrete slabs with bent rebar, on a scorched base.

objects.name: Military vehicle wreck
objects.description: Big clutter. Olive army truck with a torn canvas cover and flat tyres (about 5.5 cells), a burnt jeep sunk on its rims (about 3.3 cells) or a tracked carrier with a shot hole (about 5.5 cells), all rusted and scorched.

objects.name: Fuel drums
objects.description: Small clutter. Olive steel drums with ribs, a stencil patch and rust; burst: torn lid and an oil stain.

objects.name: Sandbags
objects.description: Small clutter. Dark khaki sandbags, a 3-2-1 stack or a two-row wall, with spilled sand.

objects.name: Shell boxes
objects.description: Small clutter. Dark olive steel shell boxes with stencil bars and loose shells (the depot shells), dark and stacked so they never read as a pickup.

objects.name: Ammo bonus
objects.description: Bonus pickup, taken on touch once per level: +350 machine-gun ammo, cap 999 (KLEV1.EXE 5:0x5493). Original look unknown (not in the map tiles); ours is an olive ammo can with rounds on top. Level 2 cell 129, floor 41.

objects.name: Energy bonus
objects.description: Bonus pickup (battery), taken on touch once per level: energy +90 of the 90 max, a full refill (KLEV1.EXE 5:0x4F0E). Original look unknown; ours is an upright green cell with a lit gauge. Level 2 cell 83, floor 23; the level 1 battery (cell 126, floor 23) sits on a floor our map walls in, so it is not placed.

objects.name: Shield bonus
objects.description: Bonus pickup, taken on touch once per level: shields +1, cap 5 (KLEV1.EXE 5:0x5D0B). Original look unknown; ours is a blue hex emitter on a stand. Level 1 cell 24, floor 23; level 2 cell 41, floor 41.

objects.name: Energy drop
objects.description: Difficulty assist SPECIAL ENEMIES DROP ENERGY: a special enemy kill (mesto flyer, vesnice rocket robot) drops it, taken on touch: energy +50, half the level energy bonus, so it is a smaller cell with half its gauge lit (user, 2026-11-07).
